name.value: Art Gallery Of Golden-Kicking Horse Culture

description.value: The Art Gallery of Golden (AGOG) is a non-profit gallery and studio gift shop in downtown Golden that serves as a cultural hub for the Columbia Valley. It presents 8–10 exhibitions annually featuring contemporary and regional work, and the Studio Gift Shop carries pieces from over 100 artists across the Columbia River Basin. Part of the broader Kicking Horse Culture organization, the gallery is a worthwhile stop for touring cyclists passing through Golden.
